judged_text: The referer check on the embed/comments hot path changed from a cached in-process SiteSetting read to an unconditional per-request SQL query — EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? runs `where("lower(host) = ?")` against a column with no index. Every render of an embedded comments iframe now adds a database roundtrip (a non-sargable full scan) where the previous check cost zero DB reads, adding load that scales with embed traffic on popular sites.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the embed hot-path referer check to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (e.g., `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb` and `lib/topic_retriever.rb`). `host_allowed?` calls `record_for_host`, which performs a SQL lookup: `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (in `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`). The new migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates the `embeddable_hosts` table without adding any index on `host` (`db/migrate/...create_embeddable_hosts.rb`), and the use of `lower(host)` means a plain index on `host` (even if added later) wouldn’t be used without a functional index. This is a concrete per-request DB roundtrip/perf regression concern, but not a functional correctness defect by itself.
